publisher: United States Department of Transportation, Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration
ownership: Public FMCSA registration records published through the FMCSA Open Data Program and the U.S. Department of Transportation public data portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS metadata, Socrata resource API, and official data-dictionary attachment; no app token or API key is required for this bounded daily export.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata and minimized API acquisition
immutable internal retention of the selected source and dictionary
source-specific active registration, principal-office site, and establishment normalization
redistribution of approved public regulatory business fields with FMCSA attribution, sensitivity warnings, provenance, and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing the Company Census as every U.S. business, every motor-carrier location, or a real-time file
generalizing FMCSA active registration status beyond the source definition
representing a principal-office address as a verified storefront, customer-accessible site, vehicle base, or independently deliverable address
inferring a legal organization, parent company, ownership, or cross-source merge from a USDOT record, legal name, DBA, BUSINESS_ORG_ID, docket, or shared address alone
publishing officer names, phone, cell, fax, email, D&B number, mailing address, or unrelated crash, inspection, review, safety-rating, or operational metrics through this layer
using the dataset for personal profiling, harassment, or exposing a home-based proprietor beyond the source-bounded public regulatory purpose
bypassing source access controls, rate limits, alerts, or terms

field_export_policy.business_org_id_and_description: public-but-review-only-and-incomplete; preserve only as optional source classification and never use alone to infer a canonical organization

attribution: Source: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration Company Census File, obtained through the FMCSA Open Data Program and DOT public data portal.
retention: Indefinite for immutable minimized source evidence and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized public regulatory records may be redistributed with FMCSA attribution, source timestamp, source and dictionary checksums, exact filter, provenance, sensitivity warnings, and coverage limitations retained; the selected source CSV and dictionary remain internal artifacts.
personal_data_handling: A registered entity can be an individual proprietor, a legal name may be a person's name, and the reported principal office may be home-based. Contact, officer, D&B, and mailing fields are excluded before acquisition; normalized records retain explicit sensitivity warnings and only the minimum business-registration and geography fields needed for the governed purpose.
